name: Facta
tagline: Grades every claim your other bots make before it goes out
description: Sits downstream of the rest of the crew as a check on what they assert. Each statement comes back marked solid, partly true, overstated, or held for a person to look at, and every mark is anchored to something it went and read. Where it cannot confirm a thing, it says so rather than filling the gap.
author: JaimeBubblehead
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
